detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

english.note: IELTS Academic, including Online/One Skill Retake; TOEFL Home Edition/MyBest accepted. Scores must be no older than two years at application. U.S. degree or qualifying English-official-country degree/birth may exempt; consult official country list.

applicationFee.note: Limited merit waivers require GPA 3.8+, relevant wet-lab experience, no eligibility for central waiver, submitted application and supporting form/transcripts/CV. International eligibility not explicit; confirm. Central listed-program participation waivers also exist; no financial hardship waivers.

documents: Graduate-assistant questions within the online application
requirements.note: Conferred bachelor's degree required; prerequisites built into curriculum. No prior lab match required; accepted students matched with two to three labs at start. Application steps require a writing sample, although a general page teaser calls it optional; follow the explicit requirement and confirm any exception.

funding.note: All admitted doctoral students receive GRA, full tuition waiver and undated minimum stipend $2,500/month. Student fees, health insurance and $37.50 registration remain payable; legal-presence verification required.
